messages:
devon: Noticing recurring p99 tail spikes in eu-west after dedicated->shared egress transitions. Suspect token exhaustion during the handoff window.

maria: Which az and timeframe? any deploys? :mag:

devon: eu-west-az3, started ~03:12 UTC. No infra deploys. Logs show repeated handoff cycles with immediate fallback to cross-az:```2026-03-20T03:12:18Z slice=dedicated-az3 tenant=t-91 event=handoff tokens_left=0 iface=eth3 qlen=5200```

ash: Token exhaustion -> fallback -> cross-az path = added latency and egress. Could also spike inter-AZ cost.

sam: Do we have per-tenant soft-token telemetry? want to see who burns quickly.

devon: Yep. Three tenants show sharp drops during handoff, soft_tokens[t-91] 600 -> 0 in ~5s under steady RPS.

maria: Quick mitigation idea: grant a small handoff-grace credit (e.g., +150 tokens) and steer to a local burst-lane instead of immediate cross-az. Limits to avoid runaway egress.

ash: Agree. Config sketch:```egress_token_policy:
  handoff_grace_tokens: 150
  handoff_grace_ttl_s: 30
  local_burst_cap: 400
  local_burst_window_ms: 250
  fallback_policy: cross_az_if_local_exhausted
```

sam: Need to ensure this doesn't allow sustained cross-az egress for regulated customers. Add enterprise opt-out and honor pinning.

maria: Finance check: if busy tenants use the burst lane, estimate +$1.8-3.2k/mo per tenant for eu-west at current rates. I'll ask finance-bot for a 2-week delta projection.

finance-bot: cost-estimator: projecting 2-week incremental egress for 3 heavy tenants ~ $900-$2100, depending on burst usage profile.

devon: Operational plan: canary at 5% of handoffs in az3 for 2 hours. Monitor p99, egress bytes, and kvcache_miss. Abort if p99 increases or egress delta > 20%.

ash: One more: when we hand off, NVMe KV cache regen can cause extra reads and egress. Suggest we gate handoff if kvcache_miss_rate > 8% for the last 10s, do a brief 150-250ms hold to let cache warm.

sam: Good call. Also add metric tagging so the rollup dashboard can attribute egress to burst-lane vs normal.

maria: Runbook needed: how to flip burst-lane, how to revoke grace tokens, rollback steps, and finance contact if we blow spend. Put in infra-runbooks.

devon: Created draft runbook and linked it: <https://internal/runbooks/egress-grace-token-probe>. Canary controller set to 5% now.

infra-bot: canary-controller: started canary (egress-grace) on eu-west-az3 at 2026-03-20T03:45:00Z -> 5% handoffs.

sam: Watching dashboards. Thresholds: p99 > 250ms OR egress_delta > 20% => immediate rollback. Will update in 15m.

maria: Also notify sales/enterprise-ops for any customers in the canary so we can respect compliance concerns.

devon: Noted; tagging tenants T-91/T-128/T-203 as potential heavy users and excluding any with strict cross-az bans.

ash: If canary looks good, plan gradual ramp: 20% az3 -> 40% az2 -> full eu-west with autoscale. Keep finance window open for 2 weeks.

sam: Update: at +15m p99 fell ~10ms and egress delta +3%. Will keep monitoring.

maria: Thanks team. If this stabilizes tail spikes without runaway cost, we should bake the grace tokens into routing controller as a permanent knob with per-tenant caps.

devon: I'll draft a short postmortem and a permanent proposal if canary passes. Ping me for followups.

sam: :thumbsup:
